title: export.py service-providers/{service_provider_id}.json
description: One service provider's card: report.py service-provider-summary's JSON for a row of service-providers.json, for the manifest's share_import. The report has no internal columns, so the file is exactly that report plus the release's generated_at (the manifest's) - always found (a card exists only for a listed id), so always all tables and only the share note.
